flow.zh: 仲夏傍晚，和朋友在 Meadow Brook Music Festival 的草坪上，聆聽
flow.en: On a midsummer evening, with a friend on the lawn of the Meadow Brook Music Festival, listening to

zh: Detroit Symphony Orchestra 晚間演奏 Mussorgsky 的“ Pictures at an Exhibition ”雖無茂林修竹，清流湍急，但列坐草坪，一觴一詠，亦足以暢敘幽懷，
而有“欣於所遇，智得於己”的快然自足。
en: The Detroit Symphony Orchestra performed Mussorgsky's "Pictures at an Exhibition" that evening -- though there were no lush groves of tall bamboo or swift clear streams, still, seated together on the lawn, drinking a cup and reciting a verse was enough to freely voice our quiet, inward feelings,
and there is the contented self-sufficiency of 'delighting in what one meets, finding wisdom within oneself.'

zh: 夾在白鷺鷥紛飛的季節
en: The notes wander freely
Like the evening wind, about to leave yet lingering still
Bringing shimmering starlight
The Milky Way crossing the sky
Like a bookmark in a silent night
Caught in the season when egrets fly in scattered flocks
Left for later, to leaf through the mottled years

zh: 網不住繽紛跳躍的意象
en: The music turns and unfolds like a riot of blossoms
Making me afraid to echo along
Fearing the vast, boundless dusk
No net can hold the vivid, leaping images
Can only gaze silently along with the stars
Watching how the dream flies off into the distance
The evening wind still follows the melody
Wandering, turning back and forth
As if searching
The mystery of shifting light and shadow
The delicate whisper of flowers and trees
The lawn is already covered by dark night
Only the unchanging starlight remains
Keeping a charming pose
Tree shadows recede, summer already deep
Suddenly remembering
In pages steeped in the seasons
There are footprints you left behind
An echo beneath the moon
